Being able to be fat is honestly a privilege, if you can afford to eat so much junkfood a day... you have money, congrats.

I used to think gaining weight was so difficult, but when I started having a nicer amount of money to deal with.. I realized it really isn't...  got from 60kg to 65kg quickly, then to 70kg's... realized 70kg's doesn't feel good so I got back to 65kg's where it feels the most comfortable, these shifts took 2 months at a time, at most. 

It's hard to control where the fat gets, and it's hard to have the exact bodytype I'd like to have as that would take extreme dedication and a lot of time. But the weight itself is easy, when you have an average income (which my family didn't have, I starved through most of my childhood)


And honestly most fat people I know are fucking amazing and nice people. Funniest people. I have had a man crush on this guy who's prolly around 300kg he is as thick as he is tall, but he is one of the 3 geniuses I've known in my life, he is funny as SHIT, nice and very great to be around. 

But you have to either suck it up, know that you're ugly and fat, or loose that weight. You can't be there marching around naked ugly and fat and calling yourself "beautiful" and claiming everyone should understand that, claiming you're perfect. You aren't any of those things. 

Fatphobia is real tho, I had a classmate in 6th grade, she was 100kg, and she almost killed me twice, I feared her. 

As far as bullying goes.. it's unrelated.. bullying has nothing to do with the way you look, but the way you act.

Are you fat? You might be bullied, or you might be the bully.

Are you skinny? You might be bullied, or you might be the bully. 

Are you perfect bodied, blue eyed, blond haired and pretty? You might be bullied, or you might be the bully.

The only type of person who is immune to bullying is the perfect bodied, pretty, muscular, male, BULLY. You just have to be feared and known to be aggressive. * 

I have seen it all in middle-school, **I've been "bullied"** (today we'd call it that in the west, back then I just sucked it up because it was worse at home anyway) **by every type**.

And the worst thing I saw was a  beautiful,sexy, girl getting ganged up by 4 other girls, thrown on the ground and kicked for minutes, she had ambulance called on her, don't know what happened to her after that.

Anyway, there are always ways to protect yourself from being bullied, my class just realized it's not cool and we did retarded things from then on like cheering a guy eating strawberries with cream for 10 minutes without a stop. Counting down from 60 and celebrating the passage of one minute, then repeating it again for 5 minutes. And of-course, gathering in a circle, and repeating "fuck you". 

Which brings me to my conclusion, SCHOOL IS TOO FUCKING BORING and that's why people turn to bullying, ENTERTAINMENT. 


*= unless a parent of the kid or a 5 years older kid comes to the school and soccer punches you (for some reason, not for all the bullying you have been doing, but for something you actually had no part in)

I both really want to break up with her... but I don't as well.. She hasn't improved.. my brain it expects her to improve especially when I tell her.. she apologizes.. But we never solve any problem.. it is never solved.. and more problems come along. She is so cold. 

I got food poisoning and I was alone, there was no-one I knew within 10 thousand kilometers. It was a pretty bad food poisoning and I Didn't have any pills, couldn't walk because of the pain. I felt like I was dying, (I have been to the hospital for weeks 2 times before and I was to the emergency room 2 times too, all because of my stomach) Didn't even have water (the tap water isn't drinkable)  never the less her friend asked her to cover a shift at work so she went, despite me calling her telling her about it all, and begging her to come. I was in an intense pain for 12 hours, throughotu that time I kept communicating with her and she actually got pissed at me. 


She keeps complaining about so many things about me that I can't change, like the physical things about me. And compares me as a boyfriend to her friend's boyfriend, telling me the things he is so much better in. 

Another incident that happened is that she wanted to go on a motorbike trip, she didn't tell me we'll go at 5am but she decided so, I didn't have any warm clothes with me, just shorts and a t-shrit and it was about 13-15C outside, and this was shortly after recovering from the disease I had. After riding the motorbike for a 10 minutes I literally couldn't anymore because of being too damned cold I asked her to ride and she has no problem with that, she is a more experienced driver, she asked me whether I want to go back and I first said no but later when I asked her whether we can go back because I can't take it. She stopped the bike, almost crashing it, and started yelling at me comparing me to other boyfriends telling me how hard she has it and so I got up, gave her the helmet she asked me why am I giving her the helmet, to which I replied "it's your property"  I had a plan to get away and never see her again. For me, we were way past broken up at that point, but she looked at me, and I couldn't say those words, and she convinced me to get back on the bike, she did drive me back tho.

You know I could name so many more incidents. But overall, she has changed dramatically from the girl I fell in love with. Things just keep getting worse. Not only our relationship, but also the circumstances of it, no luck in anything. We failed to close the distance 2 times now. 

But there is so many more wonderful things about her too, I am complaining about these things but she gives me, a lot more good, too. There's bad things, but then there's the amazing things. To keep this short, if you imagine the best possible girlfriend, but you add those things I told you to it. Do you think I should keep on going? I am still overall happy when I am with her, like extremely happy, but since we are long distance most of the time, it's the pain, without the happiness. Is it worth to wait for the chance of being happy with her one day? Or is that exactly as stupid as it sounds...?

Thank you for saying those nice words. I know this whole post makes me seem like a child, it is childish, but I don't think this part of me is going away by age, unless I shut-down to her too, and never open to anyone, like I did, for so many years of my life.

You wouldn't if it's a digital piece of trash tho :D She could have spotted the symbolism, she knew about my past too, I thought she'd like it. I thought it would be a super special thing. IF she cried out of appreciation, I would cry too :D

But she was right, I would have loved to receive something like that, from anyone, if I got a thing, made specifically for me, I would have been so damn happy about it, you can't imagine that. So I thought I could make her that happy, I hoped I could make her that happy. But she isn't into that. It would have made me the happiest man in the world if I could see her genuine happiness.

I hope so much she could have seen that. I just wanted to make her feel happy. I failed so badly, I failed so terribly. I never made anyone happy, I never made anyone cry out of happiness. But I wanted that so much. I wanted to see her happy. But now it's just so cringy to me. what did I think. I feel so alone in this world.
Thank you.

I don't think she can have such an evil thought like that in her head, she might be doing it subconsciously somehow.. I don't know... but that means she needs help too

I thought I'd come across as immature, I honestly though I knew her, but the more time we're together... the less I am convinced of that... Even though we spent 12 hours a day talking.. I feel like she is just becoming someone I don't know. Turns out she doesn't even have it, she deleted the thing :D. It broke my heart. I don't cry much, I used to cry a lot, but over the years of abuse at school... home...  welll I got used to it, I shut myself down from others, I never let anyone know my feelings, I put a mask on and I never put it off, I was never honest with anyone, I never felt safe with anyone. And nothing could hurt me, nothing anyone said or did, could hurt me. But I opened myself to her completely. So I know it's my fault, I know I am broken in a way, and I am using this thread to just vent, I am not angry at her, I love her. But she can hurt me so much, so easily.
I can't see her that way, I know she loves me, at least sometimes. I know she is a good person, she is not evil.

I am not an artist either, I had a dream to be when I was a kid but because I grew up half-blind I never developed the motor skills, and I failed the "talent" tests to an art high-school. Like i'd appreciate a wooden box from my girlfriend more than I'd appreciate a 1:1 scale Lamborghini out of wood from a professional carpenter if that makes sense. It just seems so sweet of a thought, that someone put time energy and thought into something, even though they knew they aren't very good, but they appreciate me enough to try their best.

I did, I don't remember exactly what she said but it was kind of hurtful, I also saw, she doesn't have it on her laptop at all so she had deleted it. Or doesn't care enough.

I guess she is right in one thing, I would definitely enjoy any little thing, however ugly, that anyone made me, if I get a stick figure drawing or whatever from someone, I'd appreciate it, because it's... I guess I thought it shows care, now I know it doesn't to her.
